affected.note: Up to 934,948 order records in emails stored for some shops using EC TOOL (a third-party tool for Rakuten Ichiba and Yahoo! Shopping merchants) between 2015-08-30 and 2020-02-27. The company's investigation found no evidence that order data was accessed or transferred out. No card data or email addresses were included.

summary.en: Ryuki Design, which provides the shop management tool EC TOOL to merchants on Rakuten Ichiba and Yahoo! Shopping, said a shared database server was accessed without authorization and partly altered. The server held up to 934,948 order records with orderer and recipient names and addresses, products and amounts.
summary.ja: 楽天市場やYahoo!ショッピングの出店者向けに店舗管理ツール「EC TOOL」を提供するRyuki Designは、共通データベースサーバが不正アクセスを受け一部が改ざんされたと公表した。サーバには注文者や送付先の氏名、住所、注文商品、金額などを含む最大93万4,948件の注文情報が保存されていた。

sources.title: オンラインモールのサードパーティ製管理ツールに不正アクセス
